44445.title: Love Actually
44445.synopsis: Everywhere you look, love is causing chaos. From the bachelor Prime Minister of the United Kingdom who, on his first day at 10 Downing Street, falls in love with the girl who brings him his tea, to a hopeless sandwich delivery guy who doesn't think he has a chance with the girls in the U.K., so he heads for Wisconsin. From aging rock stars, to a stony headmistress, to a monolingual Portuguese housemaid--love arrives in many forms, shapes and sizes. Here, ten separate--but intertwining--stories of love all lead up to a big climax on Christmas Eve, proving that love is the driving force in all of these people's lives.

45156.title: Elf
45156.synopsis: As a baby, Buddy crawls into Santa's toy bag and is whisked off to the North Pole, where he is raised as an elf. A misfit who grows to be three times the size of his elf family, Buddy ultimately heads to his birthplace of New York City to seek out his roots. Unfortunately, they turn out to be a "Scrooge"-like father and a cynical ten-year-old stepbrother who doesn't believe in Santa. Worst of all, everyone seems to have forgotten the true meaning of Christmas. But using his simple elf ways, Buddy sets out to single-handedly win over his family and save Christmas in New York, hoping to at last find his true place in the world.

197686.title: Blade Runner 2049
197686.synopsis: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos.  K's discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former LAPD blade runner who has been missing for 30 years.

226509.title: Arrival
226509.synopsis: When mysterious spacecrafts touch down across the globe, an elite team - lead by expert linguist Louise Banks - is brought together to investigate. As mankind teeters on the verge of global war, Banks and the team race against time for answers - and to find them, she will take a chance that could threaten her life, and quite possibly humanity.

269068.title: Avengers: Doomsday
269068.synopsis: Heroes from three different worlds must unite when they're thrust together to confront a catastrophic danger that could destroy everything they know.

296439.title: Wildwood
296439.synopsis: The story of a courageous girl, Prue McKeel, on a desperate mission to rescue her baby brother from a forbidden forest filled with enchanted creatures, endearing allies, and formidable adversaries. Her journey unfolds into a spectacular, high-stakes adventure where the fate of an entire hidden world hangs in the balance.

313309.title: A Talent For Murder
313309.advisory: Strong sex, language and some bloody violence
313309.synopsis: A mysterious young man from a New York publisher is sent to Switzerland to persuade the renowned writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final instalment of the Ripley anthology.

322884.title: Wicker
322884.advisory: Strong sexual content, sex references and language throughout. Occasional violent scenes with brief bloody injury. Mature themes including discrimination and bereavement.
322884.synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

324508.title: Dune: Part Three
324508.advisory: Intense sci-fi action violence and threat. Not suitable for younger viewers.
324508.synopsis: Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery.  As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

1000002678.title: I Play Rocky
1000002678.advisory: Moderate sex references, infrequent strong language and some bloody injury
1000002678.synopsis: The film is an electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn’t just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told “no” at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds. The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie.

1000004528.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
1000004528.synopsis: THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING revisits the world of Panem and follows young Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) twenty-four years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the Fiftieth Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

1000014492.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
1000014492.advisory: Strong sci-fi violence, threat and bloody injury detail. Some upsetting scenes.
1000014492.synopsis:
War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.
 
There is no third time. Everything ends here.

1000014559.title: Paper Tiger
1000014559.synopsis: two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

1000016814.title: Focker-In-Law
1000016814.advisory: Moderate comic sex references and infrequent strong language
1000016814.synopsis:
This November, comedy icon and Emmy winner Ben Stiller and two-time Oscar® winner Robert De Niro reunite, joined by Grammy winner and Oscar® nominee Ariana Grande, in Focker-In-Law, a new chapter in the blockbuster Meet the Parents franchise.

 Written and directed by John Hamburg, who co-wrote the three previous Meet the Parents films, Focker-In-Law is produced by Oscar® nominee Jane Rosenthal and Robert De Niro for Tribeca Productions; Ben Stiller and Oscar® winner John Lesher for Red Hour Films.

1000017175.title: Heysel 85
1000017175.advisory: Distressing scenes with violent images and graphic injury detail. Strong language
1000017175.synopsis: In this historical drama, a journalist and a civil servant find themselves torn between duty and conscience in the traumatic aftermath of the 1985 Heysel Stadium disaster.

1000020289.title: How To Rob A Bank
1000020289.advisory: Strong language, violence and injury detail. Scene of soft drug use
1000020289.synopsis: In HOW TO ROB A BANK, a crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their beliefs - and their most ambitious heist yet.

1000020293.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
1000020293.advisory: Strong violence and bloody injury throughout. Strong language and sex references
1000020293.synopsis: A hitman is forced to go on the run with his children after the death of his wife in this US action thriller.

1000022651.title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
1000022651.advisory: Strong violence, with bloody injury detail. Strong sex and language. Drug use
1000022651.synopsis:
Brad Pitt returns to his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth, only this
time it’s 1977 and it’s a very different Hollywood.

1000027246.title: Gunmaaster G9
1000027246.advisory: Strong violence and graphic injury detail.
1000027246.synopsis: A simple dairy farmer. A ruthless deadly gang. A race against time. To save his loved ones, he must become the one man he thought he had killed forever-the most dangerous version of himself.

1000027939.title: Buddy
1000027939.advisory: Strong violence, threat and bloody detail. Infrequent strong language
1000027939.synopsis: A magical, singing orange unicorn (Keegan-Michael Key) holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.

1000033278.title: Ghost Soldier
1000033278.synopsis: In the action-thriller Ghost Soldier, Jim Caviezel stars as Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald, a solitary man with a mysterious past, living a quiet life off the grid in his hometown. But when a powerful foreign corporation descends on his community determined to seize his and his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz takes action — he’s actually a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with weapons no one has ever seen, a lifetime of lethal military training, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz becomes the one thing his enemies never anticipated: a one-man war they can’t win.

1000034007.title: Ebenezer
1000034007.advisory: Scenes of supernatural threat throughout and some disturbing images that may frighten younger children.
1000034007.synopsis: This November, Johnny Depp is Ebenezer Scrooge. The classic Christmas tale. Told like never before. From Ti West, EBENEZER also stars Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, with Tramell Tillman and Ian McKellen.

1000044518.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
1000044518.advisory: Mild threat, injury and some upsetting scenes
1000044518.synopsis: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari headline Yeh Prem Mol Liya, a Sooraj Barjatya romantic family drama that brings timeless love, cherished relationships and heartfelt emotions to the big screen.

1000048062.title: OM - Chapter 1: Udhiram: The Blood Wood
1000048062.advisory: Strong violence and bloody injury. Distressing scenes
1000048062.synopsis: An emotional drama set in a gritty world ruled by lawbreakers and law-enforcers in close proximity where Greed, Power and Poverty unleashes cruelty, criminality, violence and bloodshed.

1000048524.title: ENE Repeat
1000048524.advisory: Strong language, injury detail and crude humour
1000048524.synopsis: ENE Repeat reunites a close-knit group of friends as they embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.

1000050581.title: Dune: Part Three - The IMAX Experience
1000050581.advisory: Intense sci-fi action violence and threat. Not suitable for younger viewers.
1000050581.synopsis: Directed by Denis Villeneuve and written by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, Dune: Part Three is based on the novel Dune Messiah by Frank Herbert and delivers the epic conclusion to Villeneuve’s trilogy.

1000051707.title: You Can See Everything
1000051707.advisory: Strong language, reference to sexual violence and brief non-sexual nudity
1000051707.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to  document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss. From boundary-pushing directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim comes YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING.

1000053389.title: Hail Mary
1000053389.advisory: Moderate violence, threat and injury. Upsetting scenes.
1000053389.synopsis: A school bus driver’s life is upended when Kerala police reopen a 23-year-old missing-person case.

1000054065.title: Arthur Christmas (15th Anniversary)
1000054065.synopsis: "Arthur Christmas" at last reveals the incredible, never-before seen answer to every child's question: 'So how does Santa deliver all those presents in one night?' The answer: Santa's exhilarating, ultra-high-tech operation hidden beneath the North Pole. But at the heart of the film is a story with the ingredients of a Christmas classic - a family in a state of comic dysfunction and an unlikely hero, Arthur, with an urgent mission that must be completed before Christmas morning dawns.

1000054067.title: The Holiday (20th Anniversary)
1000054067.advisory: Moderate sex references and infrequent moderate/strong language.
1000054067.synopsis: Iris is in love with a man who is about to marry another woman. Across the globe, Amanda realizes the man she lives with has been unfaithful. Two women who have never met and live 6000 miles apart, find themselves in the exact same place. They meet online at a home exchange website and impulsively switch homes for the holiday. Iris moves into Amanda's L.A. house in sunny California as Amanda arrives in the snow covered English countryside. Shortly after arriving at their destinations, both women find the last thing either wants or expects: a new romance. Amanda is charmed by Iris' handsome brother Graham and Iris, with inspiration provided by legendary screenwriter Arthur, mends her heart when she meets film composer Miles.

1000054673.title: Dune: Part Two Reissue (2026)
1000054673.advisory: Actions scenes throughout with some intense and large scale fight sequences. Supernatural theme with moderate language and threat
1000054673.synopsis:
The saga continues as award-winning filmmaker Denis Villeneuve embarks on DUNE: PART TWO, the next chapter of Frank Herbert’s celebrated novel Dune, with an expanded all-star international ensemble cast.

DUNE: PART TWO RE-ISSUE screenings will be accompanied by sneak peek footage from DUNE: PART THREE.

1000054674.title: Dune: Part One Reissue (2026)
1000054674.synopsis:
Award-winning filmmaker Denis Villeneuve directs the big-screen adaptation of Frank Herbert’s seminal bestseller. A mythic and emotionally charged hero’s journey, DUNE tells the story of Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, who must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people. As malevolent forces explode into conflict over the planet’s exclusive supply of the most precious resource in existence—a commodity capable of unlocking humanity’s greatest potential—only those who can conquer their fear will survive.

DUNE: PART ONE REISSUE screenings will be accompanied by sneak peek footage from DUNE: PART THREE.

1000054746.title: Cosmic Samson
1000054746.advisory: Strong violence and bloody injury. Distressing scenes.
1000054746.synopsis: A pizza delivery agent gets an extraordinary twist to his routine when mysterious powers thrust him into a hidden fantasy world, setting him on a larger-than-life journey unlike anything he has known beyond his wildest dreams.

1000055125.title: Jingle All The Way (30th Anniversary)
1000055125.synopsis: Turbo Man action dolls are the christmas craze- in the spirit of real life Tickle-Me-Almo. Arnold Schwarzenegger and Sinbad mug shamelessly through this holiday slapstick about two guilt-wracked fathers racing around Minneapolis on Christmas Eve trying to buy their sons a sold-out Turbo Man.

1000055185.title: Cantona + Live Q&A
1000055185.synopsis: Follows footballer Eric Cantona, branded unmanageable and retired in disgrace at 25, who finds redemption at Manchester United under manager Alex Ferguson who channels his brilliance.
